notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP only (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124) for HTML, robots.txt and sitemap.xml. robots.txt is the Shopify default (User-agent: * / Allow: /; only /admin, /cart, /checkout, /account, ajax/filter-trap paths disallowed) - no Claude-bot restriction, no block encountered on any tier. Site's raw HTML shows a client-hydrated 'N PRODUCTS' count (empty at fetch time, e.g. literal placeholder text), so a one-off Playwright spot-check was run for 2 collections (duvets, duvet-covers) to read the rendered header text; both matched the Shopify /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 array length exactly (4/4 and 15/15), so products.json was used as the deterministic qty source for every row instead of re-running Playwright for all nodes (all counts well under the 250-item page cap, no pagination needed). TREE: built from the server-rendered mega-menu (megamenu__* markup present in raw HTML, parsed level-1/2/3 with BeautifulSoup) plus cross-check against sitemap_collections_1.xml (664 collection URLs) and a keyword scan for bedding/rug/cushion/curtain/storage/basket/etc terms. h1 of every recorded leaf was confirmed to match the requested node. QTY evidence = 'products.json?limit=250 array length' plus per-product product_type breakdown used to sanity-check content purity (flagged where mixed). EXCLUDED: no Curtains category exists anywhere on this site (absent from mega-menu and from the full sitemap keyword scan - confirmed absence, not an oversight). Sofas/chairs/tables/beds/wardrobes/TV units/sideboards/hallway-furniture/bookshelves-shelving-units/coathook/side-tables and the whole 'Living Room Storage' nav group (checked via products.json product_type: agnes shelving units, TV units, a side table, a coat hook, a sideboard, a cabinet - all Furniture-type items, no boxes/baskets/organizers) - Furniture, not Storage. Bathroom Accessories, Bathroom Mirrors, Towel Rails, Wall Hooks, Waste Bins, Coat Stands (hardware/fixtures/general accessories, not textile or storage). Home Decor/Vases/Candle Holders/Desk Accessories/Wall Art/Photo Frames/Clocks/Wallpaper (Decorative/Wall Decor). Tableware/Dinnerware/Glassware/Kitchenware (Kitchen & Dining). Lighting dropdown and all lighting subcats. Home Fragrance. Gifts/Brands/Furniture Brands/Lighting Brands/Homeware Brands/Clearance dropdowns (promotional or brand collections, rule 27, not primary-type categories). Orphaned sitemap-only collections not reachable from any navigation or on-page sub-nav (napkins, tablecloths, storage-benches, cabinets) - excluded per 'preserve actual website hierarchy'; their content also substantially duplicates products already captured under Table Linen & Settings (napkins/tablecloths) or is furniture-leaning (storage-benches = blanket boxes, cabinets = mixed lockers/highboard/display cabinet).
